## Activity

During October 2025, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 431 captures. Activity was completed through the planned operational sessions, with routine leave managed within the service. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results reported below.

## Image quality

Of the 431 captures, 33 were assessed as ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 7.7. The result should continue to be monitored through routine quality review, with attention to image capture and any recurring issues identified during service delivery.

## Grading

A total of 114 captures were graded as referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 1 day. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave, and grading activity was completed within the reported operating arrangements. These results should be considered alongside the image-quality findings when reviewing service performance for October 2025.
